issue.title: Record the decision that bulk capture templates are a declared expansion before parsing

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by every bob-cli-7w phase (.1, .2, .3, .4 and .5, as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes).
It was deferred because epic bob-cli-7w's auto decision (planner default, no human
review) was `memory_template_decision = no`. Bryan must explicitly approve before any
memory edit.

Add a new strand to the `decisions` web, for example
`sase/memory/decisions/bulk-templates-are-declared-expansion.md`, titled "Bulk Templates
Are A Declared Expansion Before Parsing", recording:

- **Claim.** Capturing a template draft `D` is exactly capturing `expand(D)`. The draft
  must open with an explicit `@@template:` header; bob never detects implicit `{N}`
  templates (the `template_header_missing` capture-parse warning only hints). Expansion
  lives only in bob; Bob Mac Capture decodes and presents the additive `template` /
  `template_row` fields. Planner, atomic commit, duplicate-ID checks, reference jobs, and
  plan budget are unchanged. Clipboard markers, `@@` declarations, and Pomodoro session
  operators are refused because they cannot safely repeat per row.
- **Why.** Runs of near-identical captures ("Apply to 29 job openings") repeated typos
  per item. Rejected alternatives: implicit header-less templates (ambiguous with prose
  containing `{0}`), a new CaptureKind or per-row subprocess, Mac-side expansion.
- **Cost.** A 12-character header line; the `:` vs `^` trade-off (`@route:{1}` links
  every row under one Pomodoro and can exceed `plan.max_links`).
- **Reopens when.** The header proves too costly in daily use, or rows need per-row child
  bullets or named placeholders.

Evidence: `research:202610/bulk_capture_template_drafts/bulk_capture_template_drafts.md`,
`plan:202610/bulk_capture_templates.md`, `docs/capture.md` § Bulk templates, bob-cli
commits 946c9b7d, 8f0baa76, 84085621, 3f2b775a, and bob-mac-capture e959476 (plus the
bob-cli-7w land tale's commits). Link `[[decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client]]` and
`[[glossary:bulk-capture]]`. Run `sase memory init`.
